title: Smallness and extension closure of the maximal alpha-compact class
statement: Let C be a locally v-small triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with v-small coproducts. Let G be essentially v-small and shift-closed, consist of alpha-small objects, satisfy G4 [def-sfb-alpha-compact-object], and generate C as a localizing class. For regular alpha, the maximal class alphaCompactObjects C alpha is essentially v-small and closed under middle vertices of distinguished triangles.

source.place: Krause (2001), Lemma 5 pages 124--125 and the maximal-class construction; Localization theory 6.2--6.3.

proof.text: G4 gives perfectness, and generation with shifts gives detection of zero. Pick a small skeleton of the generators and form its alpha-localizing hull.

Small representative sets for cones, retracts, shifts and bounded coproducts remain v-small. Iterate along a sufficiently long small regular ordinal to obtain a small skeleton of the hull. Regular support unions give alpha-smallness.

The weak-kernel triangle argument propagates G4 through the hull. The objects receiving only maps from the maximal alpha-compact class which factor through the hull form a localizing class containing the generators. Generation and the identity map exhibit every alpha-compact object as a retract of a hull object. Thus the canonical class is this essentially small triangulated hull.

proof_origin.place: Krause (2001), Lemma 5 pages 124--125 and the maximal-class construction; Localization theory 6.2--6.3.

lean.statement: theorem alphaCompactObjects_small_closed {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C] [IsTriangulated C] [HasCoproducts.{v} C] (G : ObjectProperty C) [ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{v} G] [G.IsStableUnderShift ℤ] (α : Cardinal.{v}) [Fact α.IsRegular] (hGsmall : ∀ X, G X → IsAlphaSmall X α) (hGfactor : G.IsCoproductFactorizationClass) (hGgen : ∀ (S : ObjectProperty C) [S.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms] [S.IsTriangulated], (∀ (I : Type v) (Y : I → C), (∀ i, S (Y i)) → S (∐ Y)) → G ≤ S → ∀ X, S X) : ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{v} (alphaCompactObjects C α) ∧ (alphaCompactObjects C α).IsTriangulatedClosed₂
